component.name: OpenForensic Imager
component.summary: Linux forensic acquisition and evidence review workbench

description.p: OpenForensic Imager acquires RAW and E01 images, verifies hashes, analyzes partitions, browses supported filesystems, inspects bounded file previews, and records case metadata and audit events.
Source evidence is opened read-only. Physical acquisition still requires a hardware write blocker and an examiner-managed Linux device policy.
